scripts.backend:migrate: cd backend && python3 -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.backend:migration:sql: cd backend && python3 -m alembic upgrade head --sql
scripts.e2e:maestro:check: command -v maestro >/dev/null || (echo "Maestro CLI is not installed. Install it before running npm run e2e:maestro." && exit 1)
scripts.release:check:preview: npm run verify && npm run backend:release-env:check -- production && npm run mobile:release-env:check -- preview
scripts.release:check:production: npm run verify && npm run backend:release-env:check -- production && npm run mobile:release-env:check -- production
scripts.clean:python: find backend -type d \( -name __pycache__ -o -name .pytest_cache -o -name .ruff_cache -o -name .mypy_cache -o -name '*.egg-info' \) -prune -exec rm -r {} + && find . -maxdepth 1 -type d \( -name .pytest_cache -o -name .ruff_cache -o -name .mypy_cache -o -name '*.egg-info' \) -prune -exec rm -r {} +
scripts.verify: npm run deps:check && npm run backend:lint && npm run backend:typecheck && npm run backend:test && npm run backend:demo-flow && npm run backend:load-check && npm run backend:smoke && npm run backend:migration:sql && npm run api-client:check && npm run mobile:lint && npm run mobile:typecheck && npm run mobile:smoke && npm run mobile:test
